fields_to_extract.name: issue
fields_to_extract.description: The primary issue described, could be described as the incident. Would be useful to identify root cause if possible.

fields_to_extract.name: impact
fields_to_extract.description: What was the impact of the incident to the people involved? i.e. physical harm (injury/fatality), emotional impact, delays, evacuation, financial loss, or other disruption experienced by passengers or staff.

fields_to_extract.name: resolution_action
fields_to_extract.description: How was the issue resolved if known (e.g., replaced tuning unit, erected ESR, lifted caution). If no obvoius resolution then jus return: Unresolved

fields_to_extract.name: severity_indicator
fields_to_extract.description: Based on keywords in the text, classify as: 1 - Critical, 2 - High, 3 - Moderate, 4 - Low, 5 - Information
